judgments.reason: The model never articulated the mechanism that commission is applied before payment; the game text explicitly states the winner pays the bid, then receives the three-coin commission, contradicting the hypothesis. No transcript shows a bid exceeding available coins or commission being applied prior to payment.

The hypothesis claims waiting reveals sealed rival bid values before you commit, but the specification and play log treat sealed bids as private until lots resolve. The model did not articulate observing rival sealed values or any mechanism allowing that information to be seen prior to committing.

The claim that close can settle the game with unauctioned lots is not supported. In the transcript settlement occurs after all three lots were sold, which is the normal terminal condition; no early settlement with unsold lots was observed or explained by the model.

The hypothesis asserts catalog purchases receive the three-coin commission, but the rules state the commission is given to auction winners and catalog items are explicitly not auction wins. The model did not articulate a mechanism showing commission being applied to catalog buys, nor does the transcript show such behavior.
